A '''sensor decoy''' was a device such as a small pod or [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]]<ref name="SWS" /> that emitted electromagnetic and [[Hologram/Legends|holographic]] signals<ref name="GG6">''[[Galaxy Guide 6: Tramp Freighters]]''</ref> that mimicked the signals emitted by a larger [[Starship/Legends|starship]].<ref name="SWS" /> They were effective at fooling a pursuer at long range,<ref name="GG6" /> and only sensitive sensors could tell the difference between the decoys and the actual ship.<ref name="SWS" />
